newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissho Iwai invests in Philippine sugar firm.
newsitem.headline: Nissho Iwai invests in Philippine sugar firm.

text.p: Nissho Iwai Corp and three Japanese sugar refining companies acquired preferred shares of a Philippine sugar producer in order to secure an overseas production base, Nissho Iwai said on Friday.
The companies paid about 40 million pesos ($3.6 million) for 1,875 preferred shares in Central Azucarera de la Carlota.
The shares can be converted anytime in the next four years into regular voting shares equivalent to a 15 percent stake in the company.
La Carlota produces 100,000 tonnes of raw sugar a year on Negros Island in the central Philippines.

The Roxas Group, which includes the Don Pedro sugar refinery as well as La Carlota, indicated its desire to develop a long-term partnership with the Nissho Iwai group, the Japanese trade house said in a statement.
Nissho Iwai paid about half the investment, with the remainder provided by Japanese sugar refiners Shinmeito Sugar Refining Co., Fuji Seito Co. and Nihon Sugar Refining Co., Nissho Iwai said.
La Carlota is expected to renovate its sugar production facilities with the money, Nissho Iwai said.
